title: The perovskite structure
caption: Calcium titanate, CaTiO₃, gives its name to the perovskite structure: Ti⁴⁺ at the cube centre surrounded octahedrally by six O²⁻ at the face centres, and Ca²⁺ at the corners with twelve oxygen neighbours. Many solar-cell materials share it.
alt: A cubic cell with calcium at the corners, titanium at the centre and oxygen at the face centres.
description: Ca²⁺ at the 8 corners: 1 per cell.
Ti⁴⁺ at the body centre: 1 per cell, 6 O²⁻ around it.
O²⁻ at the 6 face centres: 3 per cell. Formula CaTiO₃.
